question: Anamudi mountain is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Anamudi Mountain is located in the state of Kerala: 
 
• Anamudi is situated in the Ernakulam and Idukki districts of Kerala, on the border between the two districts. 
 
• Anamudi is the highest peak in the Western Ghats and in South India, with an elevation of 2,695 meters (8,842 ft).
 
• It's also the highest mountain in peninsular India and the largest mountain in Kerala. 
 
• The name Anamudi literally translates to "elephant's head", a reference to the mountain's resemblance to an elephant's head. 
 
• Anamudi is located in the southern part of the Elaimulam National Park, which is a combination of the Cardamom Hills, Anamalai Hills, and Palani Hills. 
 
• Anamudi is a popular tourist destination year-round.
